Study the given figure and write what happens in the situations given below.
i) As the bar magnet is slowly introduced into the solenoid
Ans:- A small deflection is observed in the galvanometer. This happens because the movement of the bar magnet induces a
small current in the solenoid due to electromagnetic induction.
ii) When the bar magnet introduced rapidly into the solenoid.
Ans:- A larger deflection is observed in the galvanometer. This is because the rate of change of magnetic flux is higher when
the magnet is moved rapidly, inducing a greater current.
iii) When the bar magnet is held stationary inside the solenoid.Cl
Ans:- No deflection is observed in the galvanometer. Since the bar magnet is stationary, there is no change in magnetic flux,
and hence no current is induced.
iv) By pulling the bar magnet out of the solenoid.
Ans:- A deflection is observed in the galvanometer, but in the opposite direction. This happens because pulling the magnet
out causes a decrease in magnetic flux, inducing a current in the opposite direction.
